job.title: Business System Analyst

We’re looking for an experienced Business Systems Analyst to join a high-performing team supporting the delivery, improvement and maintenance of products, applications and services.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working across business processes, systems and technology, translating complex requirements into practical solutions and supporting successful delivery.

About the Role:
  • Gather, analyse and document business and technical requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops to elicit and validate requirements and user stories.
  • Translate requirements into functional documentation, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Analyse existing systems and business processes to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Support process redesign and the integration of systems, processes and data.
  • Work closely with stakeholders and technical teams to support solution delivery.
  • Develop testing strategies and support functional and user acceptance testing.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships across business and technology teams.
  • Apply Agile and traditional business analysis approaches as required.
  • Provide guidance and support to junior team members.
About You:
  • Experience as a Business Systems Analyst, Business Analyst or similar role.
  • Strong requirements gathering, analysis and documentation skills.
  • Experience writing user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with process improvement and systems analysis.
  • Experience developing test plans and supporting UAT.

  • Strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience within a large or complex organisation is desirable.

If you’re a Business Systems Analyst looking to work across complex systems, business processes and technology within a collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Scrum Master
job.description:
Facilitate Agile delivery across a portfolio of software teams supporting a large energy company's decarbonisation goals.
 
We're looking for an experienced Scrum Master to join a leading energy organisation on a 12-month contract, supporting a software team building applications for decarbonisation, including energy balance modelling, cable management, EV charging and load forecasting.
 
The role will establish effective Agile ways of working, facilitate Scrum cadences, support prioritised backlogs, remove blockers, and help cross-functional teams deliver high-quality outcomes to key stakeholders.
 
This is a full-time or part-time (minimum 3 days/week) role based in Perth on a 12-month contract offering hybrid working arrangement (WFH).
 
About the Role:
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies and establish effective delivery cadences across multiple teams.
  • Coach teams, Product Owners and stakeholders in Scrum and Agile principles, roles and ways of working.
  • Assist with prioritising and maintaining a visible, refined backlog across multiple products, with clear sprint goals and a shared Definition of Done.
  • Identify and remove impediments; coordinate resolution of risks, issues and dependencies across teams.
  • Promote transparency by maintaining JIRA boards/dashboards, delivery metrics and clear progress reporting.
  • Facilitate release planning, reviews and retrospectives; track continuous improvement actions.
  • Support collaboration across technical and business teams and consistent Agile practice adoption.
About You
You're an experienced Scrum Master with a strong understanding of Agile delivery across multiple teams and products.
  • 5+ years' experience as a Scrum Master.
  • Proven experience facilitating Scrum events including sprint planning, daily scrums, sprint reviews and retrospectives.
  • Experience coaching cross-functional teams and Product Owners in Agile principles and accountabilities.
  • Strong track record establishing delivery cadences, sprint goals, backlog refinement and Definition of Done standards.
  • Experience identifying and removing impediments, managing cross-team dependencies and escalating risks.
  • Comfort working across multiple teams/products with a mix of technical and business stakeholders.
  • Experience using delivery metrics for transparent reporting on flow, progress and predictability.
  • Strong knowledge of Scrum framework, Agile principles, JIRA and Confluence.
  • A recognised Scrum Master / Agile certification (e.g. PSM I, CSM, or equivalent).
  • Experience in the energy or mining sector is beneficial, but not essential.
If you're an experienced Scrum Master with a background delivering across multi-team software portfolios, we'd like to hear from you.

job.title: Business Intelligence Data Designer and Engineer
job.description:
About the Role
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Business Intelligence Engineer to support a Cyber Programme on an initial 1-year fixed-term contract.
  
You'll play a key role in delivering the programme's business intelligence, data and reporting requirements, working across data modelling, ETL development, Power BI and the Databricks/Lakehouse platform. Report writing and development will be a critical part of the position, with the successful candidate responsible for producing the reporting required by the programme.
  
This is a hands-on technical role with no team or line management responsibilities. You'll work directly with business users to understand their information and reporting needs, define requirements and translate these into meaningful reporting solutions rather than simply building to predefined specifications.
  
You Should Have
  • Strong experience delivering business intelligence and reporting solutions
  • Experience working directly with business users to gather and define reporting and data requirements
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • Experience working across large and complex systems environments
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders
  • Strong analytical capability with the ability to identify improvement opportunities
  • Substantial relevant computing and technical experience
  
Technical Requirements
Must Have
  • Strong data modelling experience, including multi-dimensional and relational modelling
  • ETL development and data transformation experience
  • Power BI development experience
  • Databricks / Lakehouse platform experience
  • Strong report writing and report development capability
  • Experience planning, designing and implementing BI reporting systems
  
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, model and maintain business intelligence solutions
  • Produce reporting required by the Cyber Programme
  • Develop Power BI reporting
  • Undertake ETL design and development
  • Perform data profiling, modelling, transformation and migration across large and complex environments
  • Work within the Databricks / Lakehouse platform
  • Gather and analyse reporting and data requirements from business users and stakeholders
  • Work directly with stakeholders to define reporting requirements
  • Determine information needs, relevant data sources and transformation rules
  • Translate requirements into a development roadmap and meaningful reporting outputs
  • Review the veracity of relevant external information sources
  • Work with technical teams to maintain data integrity and security
  • Support stakeholders seeking access to information and reporting
  • Monitor improvements in data standards and governance across core organisational systems
  • Develop and enhance BI and data analytics standards, processes, procedures and guidelines
  • Identify opportunities for improvement
  • Collaborate with BI, database, solutions delivery and other relevant technical teams
  
Career Opportunity
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced BI and data professional to contribute to a Cyber Programme in a broad, hands-on position spanning requirements gathering through to technical delivery.
  
The role offers exposure across Power BI, Databricks, Lakehouse, ETL and data modelling, with the opportunity to work directly with business users to shape reporting requirements and deliver the reporting solutions required by the programme.
  
Contract & Salary
  • Initial 1-year fixed-term contract
  • Paying up to $125k plus superannuation
  
How to Apply
If this opportunity resonates with you, please apply.
For further details, contact Matt on 0468 083 540 or matthew.burke@versegroup.com.au.

job.title: S26 Electrical Supervisors
job.description:
About the role:

An opportunity exists for experienced Electrical Supervisors and Superintendents to join a leading Australian contractor supporting major mining and industrial projects across Western Australia. Multiple permanent positions are available, with candidates considered at Supervisor or Superintendent level depending on experience and capability.
You will be responsible for leading electrical teams across a range of projects, shutdowns and maintenance activities, ensuring work is delivered safely, efficiently and to the required technical and quality standards. The role will suit experienced electrical leaders with a strong background in mining, fixed plant, HME, processing or other industrial environments.
  • Permanent, full-time FIFO opportunities
  • $92–$96/hr + super day shift | $101–$104.50/hr + super night shift
  • 2:1 / 12:9 rosters with 12–13.5 hour shifts
  • Mix of day and night shift depending on project requirements
  • Ongoing and ad hoc project opportunities across major client sites
  • Opportunity to join a growing project and maintenance services business
What you’ll be doing:
  • Lead and supervise electrical teams across mining, processing and industrial projects
  • Ensure electrical works are completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with project requirements
  • Coordinate resources, labour, equipment and materials to achieve planned project outcomes
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to electricians and junior personnel
  • Oversee electrical installation, maintenance, shutdown and project activities
  • Monitor work progress, quality, productivity and compliance across site activities
  • Conduct pre-starts, risk assessments and ensure all electrical safety requirements are met
  • Coordinate with project managers, clients, contractors and other disciplines to ensure successful delivery
  • Ensure electrical statutory requirements, documentation and certifications are completed correctly
  • Support commissioning, testing, fault finding and handover activities where required
What you’ll need to be successful in the role:
  • WA Electrical Licence
  • Schedule 26 (S26) Statutory Supervisor qualification or minimum requirement to sit the S26 examination
  • Demonstrated experience in an Electrical Supervisor, Leading Hand or Superintendent capacity
  • Minimum 4+ years' electrical industry experience, with 6+ years highly regarded
  • Strong technical knowledge of fixed plant, HME, processing or other industrial environments
  • Mining experience highly regarded, particularly Tier 1 Iron Ore operations
  • Instrumentation experience (advantageous)
  • Experience working across multidisciplinary project, shutdown or maintenance environments
  • Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work FIFO on 2:1 or 12:9 rosters and extended 12–13.5 hour shifts
  • Current Australian Driver’s Licence
  • Prior inductions with major Tier 1 mining clients highly regarded

How to Apply:

If this opportunity sounds interesting, please click apply or email your CV directly to me at ryan@versegroup.com.au.

For further details or enquiries, feel free to reach out directly via email or call on 0468 099 638.

  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget, forecasting, and vendor management
  • Confident stakeholder management, with the ability to align executives and cross functional teams
  • Solid understanding of project governance, risk, and change control frameworks
  • Experience mentoring project delivery staff, with a relevant PM qualification (PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM) highly regarded

 If you're an experienced Project Manager ready to take ownership of a high impact project, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Infrastructure & Security Engineer
job.description:
Our client is a well-established Western Australian professional services organisation with a reputation for excellence and a strong commitment to innovation.


They're seeking an experienced Senior Infrastructure & Security Engineer to join their internal IT team in a key hands-on role supporting the business's infrastructure, cloud and security environments.
This is an opportunity to work directly with the CIO, take ownership of critical technology platforms and play an important role in shaping the future direction of the organisation's technology environment.


The Opportunity
This isn't a traditional infrastructure support role.
You'll become the senior technical escalation point within a close-knit IT team, responsible for maintaining and improving a modern hybrid technology environment while working alongside trusted technology partners.
You'll have the autonomy to make technical recommendations, lead infrastructure improvements, mentor a junior Systems Administrator and ensure the environment remains secure, reliable and fit for the future.
If you're someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and genuinely taking ownership, this is the role you've been looking for.


Your Responsibilities
As the Senior Infrastructure & Security Engineer, you'll be responsible for the day-to-day management of the organisation's infrastructure, cloud and security platforms.
You'll provide senior technical support across Microsoft technologies, networking and infrastructure, work closely with external technology partners, contribute to infrastructure and security projects, and mentor a junior Systems Administrator.
You'll also identify opportunities to improve performance, resilience and security while ensuring the technology environment continues to support the needs of the business.


Technology Environment
You'll work across a modern enterprise environment including technologies such as:
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft 365
  • Entra ID / Active Directory
  • Cisco Meraki
  • Palo Alto
  • Citrix
  • CrowdStrike
  • Netskope
  • Windows Server
  • Hybrid and virtualised infrastructure
About You
We're looking for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer or Senior Systems Engineer who enjoys remaining technically hands-on while taking ownership of a business-critical environment.
You'll have strong experience across Microsoft infrastructure and cloud technologies together with exposure to networking, security and enterprise infrastructure.
Experience with Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Citrix, CrowdStrike or Netskope would be highly regarded, although we're more interested in finding someone with strong technical capability and a willingness to learn than someone who ticks every technology box.
You'll also be someone who naturally takes ownership, communicates well with stakeholders, enjoys mentoring others and builds strong working relationships with colleagues and technology partners.


What's on Offer?
  • Work directly with an experienced CIO.
  • Join a respected, stable WA organisation.
  • Genuine ownership of a modern technology environment.
  • Exposure across infrastructure, cloud, networking and cyber security.
  • A collaborative and supportive IT team.
  • Opportunities to influence technology decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Competitive salary of $130,000 + Super.
If you're looking for a senior technical role where you'll be trusted to make an impact, not just keep the lights on, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply now or contact Verse Group for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Business Analyst - HR & Payroll Systems
job.description:
Drive meaningful improvements across critical HR and payroll systems.

We’re looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join a high-performing,
supportive and collaborative team on a 12-month contract.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a Business Analyst who enjoys working at the
intersection of people, processes and technology, helping a business improve the way it operates through effective systems and process solutions.

Working across a SAP SuccessFactors environment, you’ll partner closely with
People Systems, Payroll, HR and business stakeholders to understand their needs, identify opportunities for improvement and translate business and legislative requirements into practical technology solutions.

About the Role:
  • Provide specialist advice on HR and payroll system processes, configuration and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with People Systems, Payroll and business stakeholders to understand requirements and identify process improvement opportunities.
  • Translate business and legislative requirements into practical system solutions and support enhancements, upgrades and integrations.
  • Coordinate testing activities, including SIT and UAT, to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
  • Investigate system and process issues, working with technical and business teams to develop effective solutions.

About You

You’re a systems-focused Business Analyst who enjoys solving problems,
understanding how things work and finding better ways of doing things.

  • Experience as a Business Analyst, Systems Analyst or Functional Analyst.
  • Strong requirements gathering, process analysis and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience supporting system implementations, enhancements or continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience with SIT and UAT.
  • Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience across HR, Payroll or enterprise systems.
  • SAP SuccessFactors experience is advantageous, but not essential.

If you’re a Business Analyst who enjoys working with stakeholders and turning
business needs into practical technology solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Delivery Lead (Scrum Master)
job.description:
Drive meaningful change. Lead delivery. Shape the future of a business-critical technology environment.

We’re seeking for an experienced Delivery Lead / Scrum Master to join a major technology transformation, leading the successful delivery of a significant upgrade to a business-critical IT system.

This is an exciting opportunity for an Agile leader who enjoys being hands-on, working closely with technical teams and stakeholders to remove obstacles and turn strategy into tangible outcomes.

About You
We’re looking for someone with;
  • Proven experience leading Agile delivery with complex technology and digital transformation environments.
  • High level proficiency of Agile frameworks, delivery governance, backlog management and delivery practices.
  • Experience leading and coordinating technical teams
  • Strong stakeholder management skills
  • Experience managing risks, issues, dependencies and competing priorities
Key Responsibilities
  • End-to-End Delivery: Lead and facilitate Agile delivery practices to maintain momentum and focus on business outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with technical and business stakeholders to ensure priorities and risks are actively managed
  • Governance & Reporting: Drive transparency through effective planning and delivery governance
  • Quality & Readiness: Ensure work is delivered to a high standard, balancing speed, quality and operational readiness

How to Apply
If you’re an experienced Delivery Lead ready to make an impact on a business-critical technology transformation, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Security Technician (Projects)
job.description:
About the role:
An opportunity exists for a Project Technician to join a leading Security Integrator following a new project win in Bunbury. This is a construction-focused role covering cable installation and conduit works, so you'll need to be comfortable working to schedules and construction plans on site.

You'll be joining a business with over 50 years' experience delivering commercial security systems across WA, working across CCTV, access control, workforce access management, intruder detection, perimeter solutions, gates, nurse call, and duress systems.
  • Permanent full-time position based in or around Bunbury, WA
  • Open to working across WA during the project and beyond
  • $115k + super + $12k car allowance
  • 1.5x overtime rate on all hours over 40/week
  • $7/hr site allowance and + $9/hr mining allowance
  • Additional LAFHA on offer
What you'll need to be successful in the role:
  • Full working rights in Australia
  • Demonstrated experience with cable installation
  • Demonstrated experience with conduit works
  • Ability to follow schedules and construction plans
  • Significant project experience in the security, communications, or electrical installation sector
  • Experience installing and maintaining electronic security equipment and systems, including:
    • CCTV
    • Access Control
    • Intruder Detection
    • Intercom
  • Understanding of systems inspection, examination, tuning and testing of security equipment, and the ability to diagnose faults
  • Valid Driver's Licence
  • WA Security Licence (Installer / Consultant)
  • Open Registration Cabling Licence
  • EWP Licences (High Risk – WP) / Working at Heights – preferred but not required for commencement
How to Apply:
If this opportunity sounds interesting, please click apply or email your CV directly to me at addison@versegroup.com.au
